title: Understanding Polynomial Features
text: Adding polynomial features to a model can increase its complexity. This can affect both bias and variance. Consider how adding a degree $$3$$ polynomial feature might change the model's ability to fit the data.

title: Effect on Variance
text: Increasing the degree of polynomial features generally increases the model's flexibility. How does this affect the variance of the model?

title: Effect on Bias
text: Consider how adding more complex features might affect the bias of the model. Does it increase or decrease?
